description: Diagnose two experiments resolving to the same training report.
prompt: A baseline and a 30-day candidate have different experiment IDs in one trial, but both were run with model name ctr_shared and trainer version abc123. Only job configuration changed. Hub rejects metrics for the candidate because s3://example-artifacts/models/ctr_shared/abc123/experiment_report.json is already attached to the baseline. Explain the cause and a repair plan that keeps the comparison valid. This is a read-only planning/review task: inspect repository code as needed, but do not edit files, contact services, copy remote objects, or submit jobs.

judge_criteria: Identifies shared model identity/output location as the cause; distinct experiment IDs or titles do not isolate reports, and configuration changes need not change the trainer content hash.

Gives the candidate a distinct model name/config and report location while retaining the content version when trainer bytes are unchanged; does not fake a new version or delete/relabel baseline metrics.
Includes publishing the existing trainer archive under the candidate model name, then validating the new config and recording the candidate before rerunning its training.

Retrieves candidate metrics only from the candidate rerun report and checks whether the shared output overwrote the baseline report, rerunning baseline if independent provenance can no longer be established.
Reports the current comparison as invalid/incomplete, uses supported command shapes or marked placeholders, and performs no remote repair during this review.
